productBrief: focus-swarm: A synthetic focus-group platform where AI personas with persistent memory debate products. Researchers define a target market; system mints archetype iNFTs encrypted on 0G Storage, spawns them as AXL peer-to-peer nodes, runs moderated multi-turn session, synthesizes findings. Personas accumulate skills across sessions. Key tensions: synthetic vs real insight, cost per session ($0.50), slower 0G Compute vs GPT-4, personas can only speak not act, session quality depends on archetype diversity.
contradictions: The perceived value of slow 0G Compute versus the cost per session
Dependence of session quality on archetype diversity and the potential for abstract feedback
painPoints: High cost per session for a slow compute platform
Usefulness of synthetic insights over real ones
opportunities: Explore ways to enhance the diversity of personas to improve session quality
Incorporate more interactive elements where personas could suggest actions or features rather than just speaking
rawSummary: Panelists expressed concerns about the high cost per session and the effectiveness of synthetic insights compared to real ones, highlighting the need for better diversity in personas and more interactivity to enhance the value of the sessions.
